source: Share of births in a decade that carry one of that decade's 100 most common given names, by sex: the sum of the SSA Popular Names by Decade top-100 counts (given-names-by-decade.json) over the decade's Social Security card applicants by sex.
citation: Numerator: U.S. Social Security Administration, Popular Names by Decade, https://www.ssa.gov/oact/babynames/decades/. Denominator: SSA applicants by year and sex (n_all), 1880 to 2017, as published in the babynames data package, https://github.com/hadley/babynames/blob/master/data-raw/applicants.csv (ssa.gov returned 403 to the build environment, Oct 19, 2026).

estimated.2010s: Applicant counts end in 2017, so the 2010s denominator is the 2010 to 2017 yearly mean times ten.
estimated.2020s: No applicant counts after 2017: the 2020s hold the 2010s share (ESTIMATED).
